paragraphs.text:
You and Norman search for signs that Sylvia has gone this way. 
But while your attention is on the tracks, you may be noticed.

Make a combined Track and Luck roll: if you roll under or equal to 
both, go to 290; if you fail both, go to 315; if you only succeed with 
Track, go to 289; if you only succeed with Luck, go to 314.
